retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style ensemble portrait featuring a group in stylized Western attire beneath a large, psychedelic arched badge containing display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A horizontal line of seven figures in stylized 1970s Western wear standing in a dry, scrubby landscape under a large, multi-layered psychedelic badge that dominates the upper third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The ornate badge acts as a heavy crown over the central figures.
The warm, earthy tones of the landscape harmonize with the orange and yellow of the badge.
The figures are arranged in a shallow, linear depth across the midground.
The dark foreground scrub provides a base for the tracklist typography.
coreInvariants: Arched, multi-bordered header badge with radiating sunburst motif.
Stylized Western costumes blending 70s fashion with cowboy tropes.
Warm, desaturated color grading typical of vintage film stock.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Seven figures occupy the horizontal center, scaled to fit the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, colorful arched badge at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright badge, move down to the group portrait, and settle on the tracklist in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky between the badge and the figures provides breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and tans in the landscape and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark shadows in the foreground and clothing accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange, yellow, and pink within the psychedelic badge.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic badge contrasts with the muted, naturalistic tones of the photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and condensed sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Display text is thick and blocky to withstand heavy bordering.
Secondary text follows the curve of the graphic elements.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Arched baseline for the artist name within the badge.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for titles paired with a functional condensed sans for details.

preserve: The arched shape of the header
The yellow-on-black contrast for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif feel of the main title.
Appropriate for the secondary tracklist text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of seven people in 1970s Western costumes standing in a dry, scrubby field at dusk. Leave the top third of the image clear for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ornate, multi-colored arched badge at the top center. Place heavy yellow slab-serif text inside the black bar of the badge. Add a list of text in the bottom right corner in a tan condensed font.

verificationChecks: Is the badge arched and multi-layered?
Are the costumes a mix of 70s fashion and Western wear?
Is the color palette warm and vintage?
Is the main title in a heavy slab-serif font?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between graphic and photographic elements
avoid: Clean, modern vector lines in the badge

postGenerationChecks: Check that the badge does not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Ensure the tracklist text is legible against the dark foreground.
Verify the 'sunburst' effect in the badge is centered.
Confirm the overall color temperature is warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a group portrait in themed attire with a dominant, stylized graphic header that encapsulates the title in a vintage display font.
